title: Ubuntu on WSL2 Expert
description: Become fluent operating Ubuntu under WSL2 for software development — from core command-line skills through Bash automation, Linux permissions/networking, and the Windows/WSL2 architecture — able to diagnose environment problems from first principles.

nodes.label: Essential Commands
nodes.description: Navigate and manipulate the filesystem from memory with pwd, ls, cd, mkdir, touch, cp, mv, rm, cat, less, nano, history, and man, and manage packages with apt and sudo — the baseline vocabulary for daily Linux work.
